order_account.boundary: Revenue growth is only a monetization proxy; the selected archive does not provide a comparable contracts or backlog series.

cash_account.unit_note: Archive figures stated in 億美元 are divided by ten for USD billions.

consumables_account.boundary: These are market-price volatility proxies, not physical electricity use, chip consumption, depreciation, or unit cost.

risk_account.boundary: One live option-chain snapshot locates protection demand but does not establish a stable causal relationship.

limitations: The allowlist ends with a 2026-07-28 archive written before that week's four-company earnings; it cannot support claims about post-earnings results as of the digest date.
The order account uses reported revenue growth as a proxy because the selected archive set has no harmonized bookings, contracts, remaining-performance-obligation, or backlog series.

Archive accounting scopes are not harmonized. In particular, mile_89889d46 reports 2026Q1 four-company CapEx of USD 80.2B while mile_2d1d356b reports USD 129.8B; this snapshot preserves both and does not combine them.
The consumables account uses securities volatility to test whether chip and power narratives are priced; it does not measure physical quantities or unit economics.
Option-chain figures are a single dated cross-section and can change after earnings or market moves.
All results are descriptive archive evidence, not causal tests, strategy backtests, forecasts, or investment advice.
